trial.seed_rule: trial i uses seed base_seed+i; base_seed=20260910

stimulus.type: PoissonInput per GRN, N=1, weight=w_syn*f_poi, refractory of stimulated GRNs set to 0

readout.aggregation_rationale: Stimulate XLSX Root_Side L sugar, mirroring the female frozen set side. Read contralateral XLSX R MN9 (16949); also record XLSX L MN9 (10331). Shiu historical left/right aliases are not XLSX side labels.
readout.rate_definition: spikes in [0, duration] / duration, mean over trials; also report std over trials

A_prime_sugar_lb3c.note: Two fresh 120 Hz conditions; neither is in the A-D 420 trials. Not executed at M0.

notes: Paper calibrated w_syn on FlyWire v630; we run v783 only, absolute Hz may differ.
Model baseline firing is 0 Hz by construction (no intrinsic activity); condition D measures it anyway.

male_provenance.model_parameters: Inherited byte-for-value unchanged, including model.source attribution.
male_provenance.scope: Whole CNS; M0 only baseline and sugar200 five-trial benchmarks. M1/M2 require checkpoints.
male_provenance.calibration: Transfer is a model assumption, not male behavioural calibration.

rescale_provenance.ratio_definition: (male contra mean + male ipsi mean)/(female contra mean + female ipsi mean), using min(200, available) strongest partners per MN9; male R has 137, other neighborhoods 200; equal side weights.
rescale_provenance.precision: Full precision of approved mean-based definition; displayed rounded weights are 0.145104 and 0.138504 mV.
rescale_provenance.external_kick: w_syn*f_poi remains tied; f_poi unchanged. Not recurrent-only rescaling.
rescale_provenance.overrides: Only model.w_syn_mV changes. Inherited male_provenance describes M0, superseded for this field and adapter by this record.
rescale_provenance.scope: A-D plus both A-prime arms only; 480 trials; no Phase 1 or M2.
rescale_provenance.readout: Both MN9 sides independently gated; inherited primary field is historical, no new primary chosen.
rescale_provenance.stop_rule: Pass only if all historical A-D gates pass on at least one side. If neither candidate passes, male line stops; no third weight.
